display_long_description:
Step into immersive VR anatomy labs that bring the human body to life at organ, tissue, and cellular levels. Designed for elementary, middle, and high school learners, each lab transforms complex biology into intuitive, hands-on discovery through vivid, animated 3D simulations aligned with classroom standards. Learning feels like exploration, curiosity-driven, confidence-building, and genuinely fun.

Dive into live medical imaging, moving through organs and body systems layer by layer to reveal how structures connect under the surface. Select anatomy structures to hear Dr. Hana Sato, your virtual guide, explain their structure and function, just like in a real lab. Use natural hand-tracking to grab, rotate, and inspect anatomy objects in stunning detail, building spatial understanding that textbooks can’t match.

Learning deepens through play. Assemble organs and entire systems in 3D puzzle challenges, reinforcing structure–function relationships piece by piece. Test your understanding with audio-based quizzes led by Dr. Sato, then jump into a fast-paced, ninja-style knowledge knockout game where she calls out targets and you punch the correct anatomy on the clock. Every activity is designed to reinforce concepts through action, feedback, and repetition—without feeling like a test.

This free version includes full access to the Cardiovascular System lab. Additional anatomy labs are coming soon, including skeletal, muscular, digestive, respiratory, vision, hearing, and more.
